items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I never met the daughter, as well as I knew Marie and Ray.

ctx.x: It's our culture, and they are closer to it...

They know more about it than most people here do. In Germany, for instance, after a break someone comes up to me with a book and says, "Hey, your first record date was with Louis Armstrong on such-and-such a date, and there was Paul Barbarin on drums and Luis Russell played the piano, and Charlie Holmes played the alto saxophone, and Louis sang "Once In A While" and "Sunny Side of the Street." When I think of "Sunny Side of the Street"... Would you remember Marie Bryant, by any chance?
